description: NaHSeO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.49 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-65°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.78 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom.
